extracted text: The paper focuses on the microstructure and mechanical properties of aluminum alloy AA2219 in different thermomechanical processing conditions. The material used in the study is AA2219-T87 plate of 40 mm thickness that was cut into bars with a cross-section of 40 mm × 40 mm. Some bars were solution treated at 808 K (535 °C) for 1 hour, water quenched, and subsequently cryorolled. Cryorolling was achieved by dipping the bars in liquid nitrogen for 30 minutes before the first pass and 15 minutes in between multiple passes. Some bars were further annealed at 623 K (350 °C) for 1 hour and cold water quenched. The study shows that AA2219 contains CuAl₂ particles and intermetallic compounds (Al₆Mn, Al₇Cu₂Fe).
